title: Side
description: Which empty side band beside the catch playfield holds the heatmap during play: right (under score/accuracy, the default) or left (under the health bar). On the results screen it sits in the right of osu!'s header strip.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the heatmap horizontally (1920×1080 px; negative = left) for skins that place their HUD differently.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the heatmap vertically (1920×1080 px; negative = up).

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. Keep it so the heatmap stays inside the side band (it is 336 px wide at 1).

title: Backing
description: none: numbers and the strip float on the game, with a soft ground only under the strip. scrim: adds a soft dark wash behind the whole cluster for very bright maps. panel: the solid 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Highlight colour
description: map: the live catcher and dash light take the current map's tonal accent (derived from its background, never shown). 18-lab: always 18-LAB amber. Heat colours are fixed.

title: Heatmap bins
description: How many columns the 0–512 playfield is split into. Fewer bins read as broad zones, more show fine positioning. Changes apply to the whole attempt instantly.

title: Colour intensity
description: Brightness curve of the heat colours, 0.25–4. 1 is linear; higher values lift rarely visited zones, lower values keep only the hottest spots bright. Bar heights stay linear.

title: Show catcher marker
description: Draw the live catcher (true catch range for the map's CS, filled while dashing) and its position line during play.

title: Show on results
description: Keep the finished attempt's heatmap on the results screen, in the free right part of osu!'s header strip. osu! itself never shows where the catcher spent its time.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Show the 18—LAB tag above the strip.
